about: VS Code theme import (crates/theme vscode.rs compile_source): each case's files are written under a fresh folder, `entry` compiled (with `familyId`, `familyName`, `sourceUrl`, revision "local", license "User supplied"), and the compilation must equal `expected`, the folder's path written as $ROOT. The Rust side writes `expected` (UPDATE_THEME_VECTORS=1 cargo test -p harness-theme --test import_vectors); harness-nano's themes_import.zig runs the same cases.

{
  // A made-up theme.
  "name": "Midnight Ink",
  "type": "dark",
  "colors": {
    "editor.background": "#101218",
    "sideBar.background": "#0c0e13",
    "foreground": "#3a3f4b",
    "editor.foreground": "not-a-color",
    "descriptionForeground": "#777",
    "button.background": "#3b82f6",
    "button.foreground": "#0b1020",
    "focusBorder": "#1e2a44",
    "textLink.foreground": "#82aaff",
    "list.hoverBackground": "#ffffff10",
    "editorError.foreground": "#a33",
    "terminal.ansiRed": "#ff5555", /* trailing comma next */
  },
  "tokenColors": [
    { "scope": "comment", "settings": { "foreground": "#6a7280", "fontStyle": "italic" } },
    { "scope": ["keyword", "storage.type"], "settings": { "foreground": "#c792ea" } },
    { "scope": "string, constant.numeric", "settings": { "foreground": "#c3e88d" } },
    { "scope": "variable", "settings": { "foreground": "bogus" } },
  ],
  "semanticTokenColors": {
    "function": "#82aaff",
    "variable.readonly": { "foreground": "#f78c6c", "fontStyle": "bold" },
  },
}
